description: This file defines a PHP class 'BuzzLikeOnCommentSearchFilterParams' which extends FilterParams. The class is used to represent filter parameters for searching likes on comments within the 'Buzz' module of the OrangeHRM system, including allowed sort fields and a comment ID filter.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnCommentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object used for filtering search results for likes on comments, allowing filtering by comment ID and sorting by specific fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters by setting a default sort field to 'commentLike.likedAtUtc'.

methods.name: getCommentId
methods.description: Returns the current comment ID filter; null if not set.

methods.name: setCommentId
methods.description: Sets the comment ID filter to a specific value or null.
